Anouck Vrancken Peeters (born 13 February 2003) is a Dutch tennis player. She has career-high WTA ranking of No. 334 in singles achieved on 27 October 2025. [ 1 ] [ 2 ] Career [ edit ] She is from The Hague and is a member of LTC Naaldwijk tennis club. [ 3 ] She turned professional in 2023 and reached her first senior final in August of that year. [ 4 ] In January 2025, she defeated Nikola Bartůňková of the Czech Republic to reach the final of the W15 indoor event in Oslo. [ 5 ] In the final she defeated Josy Daems of Germany for her first senior title. [ 6 ] She won a second W15 title in Bucharest in February 2025, beating Anastasia Kulikova in the final. [ 7 ] In March 2025, he defeated Czech player Anna Sisková for another title at that level, in Sharm el-Sheikh . [ 8 ] In June 2025, she was awarded a wildcard into the women’s singles at the 2025 Libéma Open for her WTA Tour debut, where she was drawn against Lulu Sun of New Zealand.
